workout.heading: WORKOUT
workout.rules:
1. Rest Period between Each Exercise can be 60 seconds to 180 seconds depending upon your recovery. It's fine to take Additional rest if needed.
2. RIR - RIR stands for "REPS IN RESERVE", which means the number of reps you are keeping in reserve before failure.. For example, in a given number of rep range in any Exercise you Performed 8 reps, although your strength was to do 2 more reps & fail at 10 reps but as you stopped at 8, 10 - 8 = 2, this 2 rep margin became your RIR.. Other Than last set of each exercise, stay between 2-3 RIR.
3. Choose a weight such that you hit the target rep range & reach near failure.
4. TEMPO (Speed Of the Rep): Overall keep controlled tempo just keep in mind, heavier the weight, more controlled tempo should be there. In most Exercises it will be roughly 3-4 seconds of eccentrics (Releasing the weight down/up), 1-2 seconds of concentrics (Pushing /Pressing/pulling phase) & 0-1 second of isometric (contraction/hold phase) pause.
5. If you notice that your concentric is going slower than your eccentric, it means the weight you are lifting is heavy for you, decrease it in the next set.
6. You can choose any 4 days for the below Exercise Regime in a week, However Prefer to do 2 days ON 1 day OFF. In case you miss any day due to any reasons, it's fine to do 4 days consecutively.
7. SUPER SET: 1 Exercise followed by Another exercise with no or minimal rest in between.
8. SINGLE DROP SET: After finishing the respective set Decreasing approx 10% of weight once (without rest), continuing performing the same exercise till failure.
9. DOUBLE/TRIPLE DROP SET: After finishing the respective set Decreasing approx 10% of weight (without rest), continuing performing the same exercise till failure followed by repeating this 1 more time (Decreasing weight total 2 times) In Double drop & 2 more time (Decreasing weight total 3 times) in Triple Drop set.
10. At any given point of time, you experience any discomfort/ strain/pain/short Of breath/palpitation /dizziness/heaviness in the head etc symptoms, stop the exercise right away. Do not hesitate To either call me or your doctor for the same.

diet.rules:
*DIET PROTOCOLS TO BE FOLLOWED*
1. COOKING:
- You can cook any style you want to, but the amount of oil & the other foods ingredients should remain the same as mentioned in the plan.
- Any calorie free condiments, herbs & spices are fine. You can use them according to your taste.
- It’s fine to add & use extra ginger, garlic, onions etc.
2. MEAL TIMINGS:
- Nothing to be eaten in between meals
- Try to have all meals at comparatively fixed times. Changing meal timings daily can disrupt digestion.
MEALS SWAPPING: All the major meals can be swapped with each other, by this I mean whole meal, you can not swap the ingredients here n there. All meals need to be spaced at least 2.5 to 3.5 hours apart.
3. MEASURING FOODS:
- All foods mentioned in the plan are to be measured before cooking i.e. *RAW/DRY/UNCOOKED*, unless otherwise mentioned.
- All food qualities must be measured using a *DIGITAL FOOD WEIGHING SCALE.*
4. VEGETABLES - You can consume any of the following:
- Cauliflower
- Broccoli
- Kale
- Cabbage
- Bok choy
- Asparagus
- Celery
- Green Peas (Use 70% lessor quantity than other veggies)
- Spinach
- French beans
- Arugula
- Mushrooms
- Cucumbers
- Squash
- Zucchini
- Bell Peppers
- Carrots
- If you want to have anything else, ask me once before.
- Vegetables To Be Avoided:
- Potatoes/Sweet Potatoes (only to be eaten if mentioned in the plan)
- Sweet / Baby Corns (only to be eaten if mentioned in the plan)
5. SUGAR SUBSTITUTES:
- You are not allowed to use Refined Sugar or Jaggery/honey etc. Unless it's mentioned in your plan below.
- It is completely fine to use zero calorie sugar substitutes *(In moderation)* such as: Stevia, Sucralose (Sugarfree Natura) or monk Fruit extract.
- They are backed up with a lot of research & have been cleared of any side effects (If consumed in Moderation)
- In large quantities they might cause a laxative effect & large quantities means above 20-30 spoons a day.
- BEVERAGES:
- All calorie free beverages are allowed.
- These can be consumed in between meals also.
- You can also add *SUGAR SUBSTITUTES* to them
- You can count these towards your daily water intake too.
- It is fine to consume the following without asking me:
- Black Coffee/Green Tea/Diet coke/pepsi/Flavoured sugar free sodas
- Tea & Coffee needs to be prepared without milk (use milk only if mentioned in the diet plan).
6. CHEAT MEAL:
1. YOU ARE ALLOWED TO HAVE *1 CHEAT* MEAL PER WEEK
2. Depending upon how much you ate, on the day or the following day of a cheat meal, avoid having carbohydrate & fat portions in any 3 meals
3. Just try to meet your protein goals for those meals. e.g. if normal meals had whey/egg whites/chicken (Proteins), Roti/breads/fruits/dates (Carbs), oils/nuts (Fats), then just have Proteins & vegetables/salads part ONLY from those 3 meals
4. You can have anything you feel like, just keeping Balanced/limited portions in mind, Avoid sweets & over eating.

diet.cardio:
*CARDIO, STEPS & BREATHING*
- 56000 Steps minimum per Week (8000 Per Day Average target to be achieved)
- 90 minutes total Cardio to be done per week. It can be done as 30min × 3 sessions or 45min × 2 sessions or 90 × 1 Sessions as convenient for you to complete within a week. It should not be performed before your weight training session, it should be done either post your weight session or Preferably in the morning fasted
- It can be performed by bicycling, stationary bike, elliptical trainer, slow pace outdoor jogging etc. Increase speed for a couple of minutes when you feel your heart rate has raised, then you can slow down again.
- Try to maintain your BPM (beats per minute) between 130-140 bpm for majority of the session, to monitor your pulse either use a smart watch if you have or while using an equipment keep your hands on the pulse detector throughout or you may check through your radial Artery
- Anulom Vilom - (long inhale from one nostril, blocking the other followed by exhaling from other nostril & vise versa) for exactly 5min. Breathing Exercise is to be done EVERYDAY, in fresh air at morning time only. (If time allows)
